description: This file defines the RangeFilterProvider class which implements ILuceneBooleanFilterProvider. It creates filtered Lucene queries based on range conditions specified in JSON format, supporting numeric and string ranges with optional boost parameters.

classes.name: RangeFilterProvider
classes.description: Provides functionality to create range-based Lucene filters from JSON input, supporting numeric and string ranges with optional boost.

methods.name: CreateFilteredQuery
methods.description: Creates a filtered Lucene query based on range conditions specified in JSON, supporting numeric and string ranges, with optional boost.
